findings.title: Demand met every hour
findings.detail: No unserved energy in the simulated year.

findings.title: No deficit left for storage after firm resources
findings.detail: Gas and grid imports alone cover every hour after renewables. The battery shifts solar and cuts fuel and imports; reliability doesn't depend on it.

findings.title: Firm capacity covers peak with margin
findings.detail: Firm capacity 1,748 MW vs facility peak 1,104 MW (+58.3% margin; simulated max 994 MW). Counted: gas CC 659, battery 789, grid imports 300 MW; gas derated by forced-outage rate 5% (CC); 8 h battery credited 57% against a typical 14 h daily deficit; solar/wind at their average output in the 100 highest net-load hours (0% / 0%). Screening estimate, not an ELCC study.

findings.title: Worst renewable drought is covered
findings.detail: Lowest 72 h of solar + wind starts Nov 19 17:00 PST: 18,133 MWh, 21% of a typical 72 h. Firm resources carried it.

findings.title: N-1: losing the largest gas unit adds 86 unmet hours
findings.detail: Largest gas unit: a 347 MW CC block (2 assumed for 694 MW, <= 400 MW each), forced out for the tightest 7 days (from Nov 20 00:00 PST, most gas + imports). 26,827 MWh more unserved that week (beyond the base case). A data center usually needs N+1 firm supply (a spare unit or more import capacity).

findings.title: Rides through a July heat wave
findings.detail: Hottest 7 days of July 2024 at the site (from Jul 1 00:00 PST, up to 39 C observed), rerun +2 C hotter: peak load 1,104 MW with extra cooling, gas output down up to 73 MW in the heat, day-ahead prices up to $189/MWh. Demand met every hour.

findings.title: Grid imports near the interconnection limit
findings.detail: Peak load-serving import 300 MW is 100% of the 300 MW limit, so there's no headroom for contingencies.

findings.title: 300 MW fits a 230 kV tie
findings.detail: One 230 kV circuit typically carries 400-600 MW; this campus needs 300 MW at the 230 kV POI (scenario).

findings.title: Interconnection capacity not verified
findings.detail: Import/export limits are planning assumptions. Real capacity and cost need a CAISO interconnection study.

findings.title: 29% of renewable output curtailed
findings.detail: Surplus solar/wind with nowhere to go. More storage, export capacity, or less PV would raise its value.

findings.title: Grid outage: 76.0% of critical energy served
findings.detail: 24 h outage, 5,726.8 MWh critical load unserved; 0 h before first shortfall. Complete grid loss in the most energy-constrained screened window; actual preceding SOC, critical load only, gas derated 5% CC / 8% CT. Assumes islanding controls and continuous gas supply. N-1 removes the larger of one grid tie or one assumed gas unit (≤400 MW CC / ≤100 MW CT); excludes intermittent renewables and energy-limited batteries from sustained firm capacity. This is a screening heuristic, not exhaustive outage dispatch or a reliability probability.

findings.title: Sustained N-1 firm supply coverage
findings.detail: 629.5 MW remains after loss of the largest 329.5 MW contingency. Complete grid loss in the most energy-constrained screened window; actual preceding SOC, critical load only, gas derated 5% CC / 8% CT. Assumes islanding controls and continuous gas supply. N-1 removes the larger of one grid tie or one assumed gas unit (≤400 MW CC / ≤100 MW CT); excludes intermittent renewables and energy-limited batteries from sustained firm capacity. This is a screening heuristic, not exhaustive outage dispatch or a reliability probability.

findings.title: Remote solar/wind needs transmission service and a utility study
findings.detail: 444 MW of solar and 216 MW of wind sit at 5 site-model cell(s) up to 445 km from the campus. The dispatch counts their output as delivered to the campus every hour, which needs transmission service to the campus and an interconnection study at each cell; each gen-tie is a screening estimate (distance to the nearest 220 kV+ line). Site candidates are screening candidates, not buildable sites.
